capabilities: Move checked cards automatically to a marked complete list
Restore uncompleted or unarchived cards to their recorded source list and position
Record and display card created and completed times with configurable formats
Sort and group cards by text, date, tags, time, or inline metadata
Set per-list background colors and persist per-list settings
extras: README is bilingual (English/Chinese) and warns that the preview GIF is about 2 MB; installable from Community Plugins or GitHub Releases.
intentEvidence: This project is modified and extended from community-archive/obsidian-kanban.
motivation: The author modified and extended the original obsidian-kanban project to add these workflow capabilities.
problem: The original Kanban plugin lacks automatic movement of completed cards, source-list restoration, card time records, time-based sorting, and per-list styling.

relations.evidence: This project is modified and extended from community-archive/obsidian-kanban.

summary: Markdown-backed Kanban board plugin that adds automatic complete-list movement, source tracking, unarchive, card time records, sorting, and list colors.
